runtimes.summary: Cross-platform CPU translation in an isolated WebAssembly worker.
Local GGUF inference in the packaged HY-MT 2 translation helper.
Local CPU/GPU execution of Whisper models via whisper.cpp.
Cross-platform CPU execution of ONNX models.

families.summary: Fast, compact local translation using the same Bergamot engine and released models as Firefox.
Local multilingual translation across all supported HY-MT 2 languages.

Transcribes after each pause. Whisper provides more accurate timestamps than other model families, including optional word-level timing. Tiny and Base favor speed, Small balances speed and quality, and Medium and Large favor quality.
High-quality batch transcription with multi-gigabyte download and memory requirements.
Shows words while you speak. Tiny favors lower resource use, Small balances speed and quality, and Medium favors quality.
High-accuracy multilingual streaming with a larger download and higher resource use. Moonshine Small remains the recommended English live-dictation default.
Local read-aloud synthesis in English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, and Italian with selectable curated voices and pitch-preserving speed control.
Lightning-fast on-device multilingual TTS via ONNX Runtime.

collections.summary: Offline English-anchored translation with released directions downloaded on demand.
Optional local multilingual translation with Tencent HY-MT 2.
CPU-friendly models for the current desktop dictation scope.
Cohere Transcribe ONNX models in three quality tiers.
English live-dictation models in three quality tiers.
Multilingual streaming transcription using the pinned 560 ms int8 export.
Supertonic 3 multilingual local read-aloud model and built-in voices.
Local multilingual read-aloud models and curated voice embeddings.

models.summary: Fastest model with lowest resource cost. Good for testing or low-power machines.
notes: Fastest inference but lowest accuracy. Best for quick tests or constrained hardware.
Upgrade to Small or Base for everyday dictation quality.

models.summary: Fast model with decent accuracy. A good choice for quick drafts on CPU.
notes: Noticeably better accuracy than Tiny with a small size increase.
Still very fast on modern CPUs.

models.summary: Balances transcription quality, download size, and CPU speed.
notes: A middle ground between the faster Base model and the more accurate Medium model.
Uses the Q5_1 artifact listed below.

models.summary: High-accuracy model for users who prioritize transcription quality over speed.
notes: Significantly better accuracy than Small, especially with technical vocabulary.
CPU inference is slower — consider GPU acceleration or patience.

models.summary: Multilingual high-accuracy transcription with an architecture optimized for GPU acceleration.
notes: Highest accuracy available. The Turbo architecture is faster than standard Large V3.
Supports automatic detection or explicit selection for the verified language list.
CPU inference is slow — best paired with hardware acceleration.

models.summary: Largest Cohere variant, preserving full model precision.
notes: Uses FP16 encoder and decoder weights.
Requires roughly 4 GB for model files.

models.summary: Middle Cohere variant by download size, using 8-bit quantization.
notes: Uses quantized encoder and decoder weights.
Smaller than FP16 but still a multi-gigabyte model.

models.summary: Smallest Cohere variant; 4-bit quantization reduces size at a quality cost.
notes: Smallest Cohere download, at about 2 GB.
Compare its accuracy with the larger variants before relying on it.

models.summary: Fastest Moonshine streaming model at 34M parameters, designed for low-end CPUs.
notes: English-only model for live, streaming dictation.
Quantized (int8) precision; the first choice for low-end hardware.

models.summary: Balanced live-dictation model at 123M parameters.
notes: English-only model for live, streaming dictation.
Quantized (int8) precision with a middle ground between Tiny and Medium.

models.summary: Most accurate Moonshine streaming model at 245M parameters.
notes: English-only model for live, streaming dictation using quantized (int8) precision.
Its published open-ASR average WER beats Whisper Large v3 while using far fewer parameters.

models.summary: NVIDIA's 0.6B multilingual RNNT, exported to int8 ONNX for cache-aware live transcription in eight verified languages.
notes: Supports manual English, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, and Japanese selection, plus automatic detection.
The four required artifacts total about 651 MiB and use the cache-aware 560 ms encoder contract.
The derived model weights are licensed under OpenMDW-1.1, not this project's MIT license. Installing or using the model accepts those terms.

models.summary: Lightning-fast local multilingual read-aloud synthesis with Supertonic 3 ONNX weights.
notes: Supertonic 3 supports 31 languages upstream; this catalog entry exposes only the eight languages currently supported by Speech Kit.
The initial install includes the model and F1 voice; the remaining nine built-in voices are optional downloads.
Synthesis runs locally on CPU with ONNX Runtime and produces 44.1 kHz mono audio.
The model weights are licensed under OpenRAIL-M, not this project's MIT license.

models.summary: Fast local English read-aloud synthesis using the pinned int8 ONNX export.
notes: The initial install includes the runtime and Alba voice; Cosette, Fantine, Javert, Jean, and Marius are optional downloads.
Synthesis produces 24 kHz mono audio. Playback speed is adjusted locally with pitch-preserving time stretch.
The model graphs and voice embeddings are licensed under CC-BY-4.0, not this project's MIT license.

models.summary: Higher-quality local French read-aloud synthesis using the pinned 24-layer int8 ONNX export.
notes: The 24-layer French model is certified for at least 1.0x real-time synthesis on Linux x86_64 CI, not uninterrupted 2x playback. It may buffer at 2x, and slower CPUs may buffer at any speed. The initial install includes Alba; other voices are optional.
Synthesis produces 24 kHz mono audio. Playback speed is adjusted locally with pitch-preserving time stretch.
The model graphs and voice embeddings are licensed under CC-BY-4.0, not this project's MIT license.

models.summary: Fast local translation with small, on-demand language downloads using models released in Firefox.
notes: Includes 96 released English-anchored directions across 49 languages.
Only the selected direction is downloaded. The Bergamot WebAssembly runtime is shared across installed directions.
The models, vocabularies, lexicons, and Bergamot runtime are SHA-256 pinned.
Inference runs locally in an isolated WebAssembly worker. Network access is used only for explicit installation.

models.summary: Smaller download and lower resource use; suitable for most local translation.
notes: Downloaded directly from Tencent only when the user explicitly installs it; model bytes are not distributed with the plugin.
Licensed under Apache-2.0; retain Tencent's upstream attribution and notices.
The smaller HY-MT 2 model uses less storage and memory and is suitable for most local translation.

models.summary: Higher-capacity local translation with a 4.62 GB download and substantially higher memory use.
notes: Downloaded directly from Tencent only when the user explicitly installs it; model bytes are not distributed with the plugin.
Licensed under Apache-2.0; retain Tencent's upstream attribution and notices.
Heavy model: the 4.62 GB download requires substantially more memory during local translation.
